statement: Dhana Yoga (the 2nd house's lord and the 11th house's lord connected by conjunction, aspect, or sign exchange) is traditionally read as carrying steady financial prosperity — accumulated wealth (2nd) reinforcing the flow of gains and income (11th), strength modulated by the dignity of the planets involved.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
